appearances.notable_actions: Commands a hundred-man guard; defends Questioner doctrine initially but shows discomfort at child-killing; suggests the Questioners may be right about Darkfriends

appearances.whereabouts: In the village with Bornhald's forces

appearances.whereabouts: Sailing Spray along the coast of Toman Head, intercepted by Seanchan, brought to Falme harbor, taken to Turak's residence
appearances.notable_actions: Tries to flee Seanchan ship but is forced to surrender when the sea erupts in flame around Spray; is questioned by Egeanin; ship is searched and cuendillar disk found; is brought before High Lord Turak; tries to lie his way out but is detained as a conversationalist for Turak
appearances.demeanor: Nervous, calculating, frightened of lords and their power; pragmatic; tries to maintain trader's facade while terrified

appearances.whereabouts: On Spray with Domon during the Seanchan encounter
appearances.notable_actions: Shouts commands to the crew; mutters prayers with eyes closed when threatened

appearances.whereabouts: Pursuing Spray on a Seanchan ship, then boarding and searching it; escorts Domon to Turak in Falme
appearances.notable_actions: Commands her ship to force Spray to surrender with fiery eruptions in the sea; boards and searches Spray; finds the cuendillar seal; takes Domon to Turak; presents the seal to Turak as a gift; explains Seanchan customs to Domon
appearances.demeanor: Arrogant, confident, cold, disciplined; proud of her damane; excited when presenting the cuendillar to Turak

appearances.whereabouts: Left on Spray to guard it while the ship sails to Falme

appearances.notable_actions: Receives the cuendillar seal from Egeanin; praises her and hints at elevation to the Blood; summons Domon; shows Domon his collection of cuendillar; refuses to let Domon leave, wanting him as a conversationalist; drinks kaf while questioning Domon
appearances.demeanor: Refined, cultured, curious, polite but absolute in authority; takes pleasure in his collection

appearances.whereabouts: On Egeanin's ship, then at the dock in Falme during the search of Spray
appearances.notable_actions: Uses the One Power to create fiery eruptions in the sea to force Spray to stop; participates in searching Spray (presumably sensing channeling or cuendillar)
appearances.demeanor: Submissive, sad, never looks up, hands folded, silent

relationships.description: Bornhald commands Byar and tries to educate him about the reality of the Questioners and the Seanchan threat
Bornhald commands Muadh and trusts him for interrogations due to his intimidating appearance
Bornhald is ordered to obey Carridin but increasingly distrusts and opposes the Questioner's tactics and strategy
Egeanin owns the damane as property and controls her through the sul'dam and a'dam
Egeanin commands Caban, a common soldier under her authority
Egeanin serves High Lord Turak and seeks his favor; presents him with the cuendillar seal as a gift
Turak detains Domon to serve as a conversationalist and fellow collector, holding him captive in polite but absolute terms
Domon is captain and Yarin appears to be his first mate or second-in-command on Spray
